verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background. Pulse's bookkeeping automation and doola's tracking of compliance obligations are vendor-run features, not automations a user sets up. Webhooks, the Partner API, and the MCP server are developer building blocks or on-demand tools, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
